panels.title: CPU pressure
panels.description: Kernel PSI events per minute received by ResMan for this resource, host scope, since the last scrape window. ResMan raises an event only while PSI_EVENT_DRIVEN is enabled and the stall threshold is exceeded, so 'PSI inactive' means no event has ever been recorded.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (rate(resman_psi_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", type="cpu", scope="system"}[$__rate_interval]) * 60)

panels.title: I/O pressure
panels.description: Kernel PSI events per minute received by ResMan for this resource, host scope, since the last scrape window. ResMan raises an event only while PSI_EVENT_DRIVEN is enabled and the stall threshold is exceeded, so 'PSI inactive' means no event has ever been recorded.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (rate(resman_psi_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", type="io", scope="system"}[$__rate_interval]) * 60)

panels.title: Memory pressure
panels.description: ResMan does not export a memory PSI value. This gauge shows memory.high breaches per minute across monitored users: the kernel is reclaiming and throttling inside authoritative user slices. 'no RAM enforcement' means no breach counter exists, which is the case when RAM limits are disabled.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (rate(resman_user_memory_high_breaches_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"}[$__rate_interval]) * 60)

panels.title: CPU limits
panels.description: Users with a CPU limit currently applied against the users eligible under the CPU policy. Read together with resman_enforcement_mode: in observation_only the daemon records intent only and no user is ever counted as limited.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_cpu_actively_limited_users_count{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})
sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_cpu_eligible_users_count{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})

panels.title: RAM limits
panels.description: Users eligible under the RAM policy, whether RAM or I/O limits are active on the host (0/1), and memory.high breaches in the window. Read together with resman_enforcement_mode: in observation_only the daemon records intent only and no user is ever counted as limited.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_ram_eligible_users_count{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})
max by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_resource_limits_active{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})

sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (increase(resman_user_memory_high_breaches_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: I/O limits
panels.description: Users eligible under the I/O policy and whether RAM or I/O limits are active on the host (0/1). Read together with resman_enforcement_mode: in observation_only the daemon records intent only and no user is ever counted as limited.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_io_eligible_users_count{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})
max by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_resource_limits_active{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})

panels.title: RAM of monitored processes
panels.description: Process-derived memory of every monitored non-system user, the subset eligible under the RAM policy, and memory.current charged to authoritative systemd user slices.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_all_users_memory_usage_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})

sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_ram_eligible_users_memory_usage_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})
sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (resman_cgroup_memory_usage_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})

panels.title: I/O by user
panels.description: Block-device read plus write throughput per user, top 10, from the io.stat-derived counters.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (username) (rate(resman_user_io_read_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(resman_user_io_write_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: RAM by user
panels.description: Process-derived memory per user, top 10.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (username) (resman_user_memory_usage_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"}))

panels.title: Load average vs online cores
panels.description: One-minute load average against the number of CPU cores ResMan sees on the host. The dashed line is the core count; load above it means runnable work is queueing.

targets.expr: resman_system_load_average{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_total_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: One-minute load average divided by the core count. Above 1.0 there is more runnable work than CPUs.

targets.expr: resman_system_load_average{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} / resman_cpu_total_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Enforcement mode
panels.description: Bounded host enforcement mode. observation_only: intent and observation only, no limit reaches the kernel. systemd_native: properties applied on authoritative systemd user slices.

targets.expr: resman_enforcement_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1

panels.title: CPU Points denominator
panels.description: Confirmed flat scheduling denominator: complete means every active sibling slice, its lifetime, programmed weight and kernel readback were confirmed; incomplete, inactive or unavailable mean the per-slice shares cannot be trusted this cycle.

targets.expr: resman_cpu_points_denominator_state{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1

panels.title: CPU Points delivery
panels.description: Observed parent state: available, throttled_parent when the finite parent quota is throttling its children, or unavailable without counter baselines.

targets.expr: resman_cpu_points_delivery_state{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1

panels.title: CPU coverage by user
panels.description: Applied process coverage of the CPU plan: complete, partial (UID split across unrelated parents, authority_split), none or unavailable.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname, username, coverage) (resman_user_cpu_points_process_coverage{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"} == 1)

panels.title: RAM coverage by user
panels.description: RAM authority coverage: refused when the slice holds runtime-owned descendants (runtime_owned_descendant) and unavailable without an authoritative user slice.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname, username, coverage) (resman_user_ram_cgroup_coverage{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"} == 1)

panels.title: I/O coverage by user
panels.description: I/O authority coverage, checked independently of CPU and RAM.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname, username, coverage) (resman_user_io_coverage{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"} == 1)

panels.title: Parent: programmed vs delivered cores
panels.description: Programmed parent quota expressed in cores against the CPU time the parent actually delivered in the common control-cycle interval, plus the time CFS throttled it. Programmed quota is nominal capacity; delivered time is the measurement.

targets.expr: resman_cpu_points_parent_quota_microseconds{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} / resman_cpu_points_parent_period_microseconds{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

resman_cpu_points_parent_usage_microseconds_delta{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} / 1e6 / resman_cpu_points_observation_interval_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

resman_cpu_points_parent_throttled_microseconds_delta{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} / 1e6 / resman_cpu_points_observation_interval_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Delivered cores by user slice
panels.description: CPU time delivered to each user slice during the same interval as the parent denominator, top 10. Compare with the programmed weight: a low share with a high weight and a throttled parent is starvation, not a policy error.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (username) (resman_user_cpu_points_leaf_usage_microseconds_delta{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname", username=~"$username"}) / 1e6 / on (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) group_left () resman_cpu_points_observation_interval_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"})

panels.title: Programmed weights
panels.description: Sum of programmed cpu.weight across guaranteed slices, the aggregate best-effort weight, and the observed sibling sum after complete confirmation. Observed absent means confirmation failed this cycle.

targets.expr: resman_cpu_points_programmed_guaranteed_weight_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_points_programmed_best_effort_weight{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_points_programmed_sibling_weight_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_points_observed_sibling_weight_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Points budget
panels.description: Configured CPU Points: reserve outside the parent, nominal pool, root and best-effort entitlements, and the guarantees in the last published plan. The plan must satisfy guarantees + root + best effort <= 1000 - reserve.

targets.expr: resman_cpu_points_reserve{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_points_nominal_parent_pool{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_points_root_entitlement{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_points_best_effort_entitlement{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_cpu_points_applied_guarantee_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Observation-only state
panels.description: Hosts without an authoritative systemd adapter remain observable but apply no limits; correlated daemon errors explain unavailable authority or runtime failures.

targets.expr: resman_enforcement_mode{mode="observation_only", cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1

sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname, component, error_type) (increase(resman_errors_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Errors by component
panels.description: Error increments by component and error type. Application errors here are the difference between requested and effective state.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname, component, error_type) (increase(resman_errors_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Limit hooks
panels.description: Hook executions by type and outcome, queued events against queue capacity, and in-flight executions. A saturated queue drops events but never cancels an applied limit.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname, hook_type, outcome) (increase(resman_limit_hook_executions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))
resman_limit_hook_queue_depth{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_limit_hook_queue_capacity{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_limit_hook_in_flight{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Control cycle duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the control cycle. Growth toward the polling interval means the daemon no longer keeps up with the host.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, cluster, environment, server_role, hostname) (rate(resman_control_cycle_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m])))

panels.title: Control cycles by trigger
panels.description: Cycles per window by trigger. PSI-triggered cycles alongside polling show that pressure events are anticipating the periodic evaluation.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, environment, server_role, hostname, trigger) (increase(resman_control_cycle_triggers_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Weighted I/O lifecycle
panels.description: Post-READY weighted-I/O state. refused_observation is retried automatically; refused_intervention requires host correction followed by reload or restart.

targets.expr: resman_io_device_weight_state{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"} == 1

panels.title: Weighted I/O proof and application
panels.description: Functional probe acceptance is independent from a complete production plan. Programmed and read-back must agree before the plan is authoritative; effect qualification is retained contention evidence only.

targets.expr: resman_io_device_weight_functionally_accepted{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_io_device_weight_programmed{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_io_device_weight_read_back{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
resman_io_device_weight_effect_qualified{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Weighted I/O attempts and partial coverage
panels.description: Classification and owned transient-probe attempts per window, plus the current number of programmed slices with partial UID workload coverage.

targets.expr: increase(resman_io_device_weight_classification_attempts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])
increase(resman_io_device_weight_probe_attempts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval])
resman_io_device_weight_partial_users{cluster=~"$cluster", environment=~"$environment", server_role=~"$server_role", hostname=~"$hostname"}
